reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: § 6 (p0047) grants documentation/contest rights to Client, not TrueLink; § 3(e) (p0037) gives Client access to usage statistics and logs; § 8(f) (p0058) is a platform-policing self-help right over TrueLink's own hosted environment, conferring no inspection of Client records or access to Client systems.

No Vendor-side audit, inspection or verification right binding the Customer appears in the supplied text, so silence is more favourable than the preferred position (annual audit, 30 days' notice, Vendor cost, no system access); classifying as compliant rather than missing is defensible because there is no counterparty right to constrain.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline was proposed (rendered text is identical to the originals) and no counterparty comment was added — the expected outcome for internal evidence findings.
The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is correctly treated as a false signal: a frequency-cap regex cannot match where no audit clause exists; it is not evidence of a deviation.

Rationale is accurate and self-consistent, and the negotiation watch note (hold to preferred parameters, fallback of annual audit on 15 days' notice at Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%) faithfully restates the playbook positions.
